targets.query:
from(bucket: "aqi36")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pm25" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["imputed"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "aqi36")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "imputation_telemetry" and r._field == "n_missing_cells")
  |> last()

panels.title: Cost: network function evaluations per window
panels.description: The hardware-independent cost unit. CSDI defaults to 50 steps x 100 samples = 5000. The Phase 2 router drives this down per gap.

panels.title: Accuracy on artificially masked cells (MAE / CRPS)
FAIRNESS: mean absolute error by station
panels.description: The panel none of the three base papers has. Aggregate MAE hides that error concentrates on the worst-served stations.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "aqi36")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pm25" and r._field == "abs_error")
  |> group(columns: ["station"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
